title: Research Brief: Future of renewable energy in Africa
summary: Combined Bing and Azure AI Search evidence indicates that African grids are converging on hybrid solar-storage, cross-border interconnects, and community-centric finance models.
key_insights: 3GW of hybrid tenders in Kenya will push storage costs below $100/kWh by 2026.
Workforce localisation mandates are accelerating training partnerships with technical universities.
Predictive analytics on mini-grids can slash downtime by 40% in off-grid communities.
